name: Nakada Shinji
source:
After being tested for cancer, Shinji is faced with his own mortality. Realizing there is no way to extend his own life, he is determined to pass on his genes to a new generation. Shinji then sets out to impregnate as many women as he can.

His 'favorite number' is 666.
